assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry.
The payer letter states the denial was because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The clinical indication note documents the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded R42.
The patient has an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction is coded Z86.73.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
The appeal is submitted 45 days from the date of service.
There are 135 days remaining until the filing deadline.
